items.title_en: Billionaire claiming he paid $4.5 million to marry actress wants it back after romance died
items.title_zh: 亿万富翁声称支付450万美元与女演员结婚，但在浪漫结束后希望收回这笔钱
items.summary_en: A Chinese billionaire has launched a legal battle against his famous former fiancée in a bid to get a refund on the huge dowry he allegedly paid to her parents. Justin Sun, the ridiculously wealthy founder of blockchain company Tron, claims that actress Jing Tian left him high and dry after he stumped up the seven-figure sum. The 36-year-old is now reportedly suing his would-be wife in the hopes of reclaiming the cash that he gave to her mother and father in return for receiving her hand in marriage . Sun - who…
items.summary_zh: 一位中国亿万富翁对其著名的前未婚妻发起了法律诉讼，要求退还据称支付给未婚妻父母的巨额嫁妆。区块链公司波场 (Tron) 的创始人贾斯汀·孙 (Justin Sun) 声称，在他支付了七位数的金额后，女演员景甜让他陷入困境。据报道，这位 36 岁的男子现在正在起诉他的未来妻子，希望收回他给她父母的现金，以换取她的收入。
